title: Nf Opt Om Auto
objective: Enable measured complete OM/MaxMin auto-selection for input-derived vector429-class local regions with exact fallback and decision evidence

handoff.summary: Calibrated the production OM selector on vector429 with fresh-process hard bounds. Only p=7 has a complete measured crossover; p=2, p=3, and p=5 remain explicitly fail-closed before OM work. Added an opt-in competitor matrix, durable raw evidence, and engine-level suppression tests.
risks: The p=2 native boundary remains the largest uncached vector429 tail.
Concurrent project profiling made the latest censored samples lower bounds; no selection claim relies on them.
next_steps: Optimize the compiled p=2 OM type/proof pipeline in its separate lane and extend eligibility only after a complete end-to-end crossover and exact lattice proof.

The integration lane owns the final build, focused selector rerun, and native-suite run after the still-active Round-2/Round-4 changes land; this lane's repair build was stopped to avoid distorting shared performance probes.
